title: Trace the remaining European type-3 tilemap lists
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI on Wine
changes: Verified the full six-row variant and both new small list paths through the original call arguments. The whole-ROM traversal for the verified VRAM row shape locates three source-backed rows beyond the 825 retained type-3 projections.
Identified 322 unowned bytes in e352, including three new rows and descriptors, three list base words and one wrapped 246-byte LZ77 stream. Both other links reuse their existing streams.
validation: Wine t889c308 attests 452 new halfwords, authenticates the E481 and E174 joins, passes 38 input guards and drains.
limitations: Other computed and type-1 source producers, live list selection and queued writes, original BIOS, native Windows, Linux and USA remain open.
